notes.title: Fingertip Shanhai 3.0 major update
notes.notes:
★We have translated every interface, form and comment, and support Chinese and English interchange. Now players can choose the language that suits them in the initial interface.

★ Added building docks. Players can sail from the dock, enter the world map, and travel around the world of mountains and seas at their fingertips.
★A world map has been added. Players can sail on the world map by boat and visit the scenery at the end of the world.
★The world map has been processed in detail, and 4 kinds of clouds, rain and sailing sounds have been added.
★We have added 11 adventure level islands, each level has its own unique scenery, background music and monsters.

★Each adventure level island has its own unique image on the world map.
★Each adventure level has its own practical notes. When your ship sails near the island you are going to, it will not only pop up basic information such as the name of the island, but also pop up what is strange on the island and the level of these monsters. And the props they dropped.
★Now monsters can drop equipment. We have adjusted the monster drop mechanism so that each monster will drop its own unique equipment.

★The role information button has been added. Now the role information can be opened in 3 ways by clicking the health bar at the top left of the player interface, the role information button on the main interface, and pressing C on the keyboard.
★Administrative buttons have been added to the main interface, and now the village administration is changed for villagers. It can be executed without having to go to the administrative hall. You can also click the administrative button in the main interface button combination menu to manage it.
★Optimized the operation of adding points and construction. Now they can only operate in Tianyu Mountain (player base).

★We have added different attack actions and sound effects for each weapon. When the player has no weapon, he can only attack with his fist (this is a fast attack action).
★In order to allow players to see their surroundings clearly in the dark, we have added a lantern for each character at night

★We added skill sound effects, battle sound effects, background music
★ Adjusted the balance of player skills

★Now the game sound can only be adjusted to 2 times the size, and can be fine-tuned
★We have optimized the waste resources in the game to make the game package smaller.

notes.title: Fingertip Mountain sea version 2.0 has been updated
notes.notes:
1 We have added three peaks in the first mountain pass of Nanshan Mountain. In the fingertip mountain pass game, all the mountains in the mountain pass will appear in the form of immortal mountains in the sea.
We have added skill system, equipment system, item system, monster system and other combat related systems
3. We hope to not only enjoy the development of business, but also hope that these developments will have a beneficial impact on player attributes or troops.
4. The game will be updated almost every week after its launch to make up for some deficiencies in the game system.
5. In the future, we will also join the soldier army to play the game of summoning monsters and the giant monster BOSS. Please stay tuned
